2.name: Nimbus
2.desc:
An AI weather companion built for Seattle. Nimbus reads the forecast, picks your outfit and dresses a husky avatar to match. From daily check-ins, it learns how each day felt and adapts its picks to fit you.

Made in collaboration with Josephine Waliman.

5.title: handbag.3d
5.name: Prosperity Bag
5.desc:
Inspired by Loewe's anagram inflated basket bag, I created my own version using the Japanese Shippo pattern for the shell. The interlocking circles symbolize harmony, prosperity, and the infinite connections between people.

3D printed shell, hand-sewn pouch.
